description: Run wells, aeration, disinfection, pH adjustment, and corrosion control at WTP-1 and WTP-2 to produce treated water
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Storage (4.6 MG) covers about 12 hours of demand while holding fire reserve; loss of treatment or unsafe chemical feed is a public health event and a Tier 1 notice trigger; RTO is the time to get production running in manual mode; RPO is the age of the last known-good PLC logic and setpoints
manual_workaround: Local (manual) control of wells, pumps, and chemical feed by licensed operators; hardwired stroke limits and analyzer alarms stay active
dependent_systems: SYS-02; SYS-01 (not required in manual mode); plant power
dependent_third_parties: Chemical suppliers; electric utility; fuel contractor

description: Keep system pressure with 6 booster stations and 4 storage tanks
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Loss of pressure risks backflow and triggers precautionary boil water notices; boosters have local pressure-switch control
manual_workaround: Local pressure-switch control at boosters; roving operators set pumps by hand

business_process: Supervisory monitoring and control (SCADA and telemetry)
description: Remote monitoring, alarms, and control of plants and 24 remote sites from the WTP-1 control room
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Manual operation of both plants and roving checks of 24 sites can be sustained about 72 hours with overtime and staff from WARN mutual aid; historian data RPO 24 h because operators also keep paper logs
manual_workaround: Manual operation; 2 roving operator trucks on 4-hour site rounds; paper logs
dependent_third_parties: SCADA integrator; radio and cellular carriers

business_process: Water quality monitoring and compliance sampling
description: Online analyzers, grab samples, lab analysis, and compliance reporting
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Chlorine residual and pH must be verified during any treatment disruption; missed compliance monitoring is a violation reportable to the state within 48 hours (40 CFR 141.31(b))
manual_workaround: Grab samples every 4 hours at plant outlets and 8 distribution stations; portable test kits; paper bench sheets

description: Run the ERP, consult the primacy agency, and issue Tier 1 and boil water notices
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Tier 1 notice no later than 24 hours after learning of a situation and primacy agency consultation within 24 hours (40 CFR 141.202(b)); RPO covers customer contact lists
manual_workaround: Offline contact list export; broadcast media; posting and door hangers
dependent_people_or_facilities: General Manager; Water Quality Supervisor; Customer Service staff

description: Answer customer calls, outage and water quality questions, service orders
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Call volume spikes during outages and notices; account lookup depends on the CIS
manual_workaround: Scripted answers; paper service order forms; callbacks after restoration

description: Bill 18,400 accounts in monthly cycles and take payments
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $2.0 million billed per month; a delayed cycle defers cash rather than losing it; tariff rules allow estimated bills
manual_workaround: Delay the cycle; estimated bills; payment processor keeps taking payments

description: Collect meter reads for billing and leak alerts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Meters store interval data for several days; manual reads possible for non-AMI meters

description: Main breaks, valve and hydrant work, locates, and flushing
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Main breaks need maps and valve locations quickly to isolate the break and limit pressure loss
manual_workaround: Printed map books in each truck; radio dispatch

mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Monthly reports are due within the first ten days of the following month (40 CFR 141.31(a)); short outages do not threaten deadlines
manual_workaround: Paper bench sheets; contract lab PDF reports

description: Time capture, payroll, onboarding and termination
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Biweekly payroll; missed payroll has legal and retention impact, especially during storm overtime
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll through the payroll provider

description: Flag unusual analyzer patterns for operator review
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Advisory only during the pilot; SCADA alarms and grab sampling are the controls of record
manual_workaround: None needed; operators rely on SCADA alarms
